title: Gardiiɗo maande Alla
intro: E nder luggiɗde e nokku ceniɗo, ruuhu barkinaaɗo ina rimɗinaa e les toppitagol Alla. Oo neɗɗo ina fotnoo waɗde darnde tiiɗnde e nder kewu kaawis, wonta seedantaagal doole e hakkille Alla mo alaa keerol. Jaɓɓungal maɓɓe hollitii goonga luggiɗiiɗo, luulndiiɗo miijooji e tabitinde maande keeriinde wonande neɗɗaagal fof.
clues: Mi suɓaama, mi laɓɓinaama e dow rewɓe jamaanu am fof.
Mi waɗtaa e les njiimaandi annabi peewɗo, keɓɗo nguura kaawisaaji e nder suudu juulde am.
Mi seerndi hoore am e ɓesngu am haa nokku keeriiɗo ngam rewde Alla.
Malaikaajo feeñi e am e mbaadi neɗɗo timmuɗo, ina addana mi kabaaru ɓiɗɗo laaɓɗo, hay so tawii mi anndaano gorko.
Caggal 6uu6ol jibinannde, mi yamiraama yo mi 6uu6nu 6uu6ol lekki paltoor ngam mi he6a nguura keso.
Nde ngartu mi e leñol am miɗo jogii ɓiɗɗo am keso oo, ɓe naamndii kam, kono ɓiɗɗo am cukalel ngel haali kaawis gila e ŋoral ngam faddaade mi.

arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَتِ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ يَـٰمَرْيَمُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱصْطَفَىٰكِ وَطَهَّرَكِ وَٱصْطَفَىٰكِ عَلَىٰ نِسَآءِ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verse: And [mention] when the angels said, "O Mary, indeed Allāh has chosen you and purified you and chosen you above the women of the worlds. (3:42)
